check.context: Single check mark with a short left stroke and a long right stroke. Used to confirm, mark done, save changes, select items, show success and tick off tasks.

close.context: Two diagonal strokes crossing in an X. Used to close windows, dialogs and panels, dismiss notices, cancel actions, clear inputs and remove items.

copy.context: Two overlapping rounded squares, one offset behind the other. Used for copy to clipboard, duplicate items, clone a file or page and copy link buttons.

download.context: Arrow pointing down into an open tray. Used for download buttons, saving files to a device, exporting reports, importing data and offline saves.

edit.context: Pencil drawn at an angle with its point toward the lower left. Used for edit buttons, rename, compose, write notes, change settings and edit mode in forms.

eye.context: Almond-shaped eye with a round pupil. Used to show or view content, preview files, toggle password visibility, count views and watch or follow items.

filter.context: Funnel shape narrowing to a short stem. Used for filter buttons, refining search results, narrowing lists, advanced filters and data queries in tables.

link.context: Two chain links joined at an angle. Used for hyperlinks, copy link, insert link in editors, share URLs, connected accounts and attached references.

minus.context: Single horizontal line. Used to remove or decrease, collapse sections, zoom out, subtract in calculators and lower quantities in steppers.

plus.context: Plus sign made of two crossing strokes. Used for add and create buttons, new items, increase quantity, expand sections, zoom in and addition in calculators.

refresh.context: Circular arrow turning clockwise with its head at the top right. Used for refresh and reload buttons, sync, retry after an error, update data and redo actions.

search.context: Magnifying glass with a round lens and a short handle toward the lower right. Used for search bars, find buttons, lookup fields, zoom and explore tabs.

settings.context: Gear with square teeth around a round hole in the middle. Used for settings pages, preferences, configuration panels, admin options and system tools.

share.context: Open-top box with an arrow rising out of it. Used for share sheets, sending content to other apps, exporting files, forwarding links and posting to social networks.

trash.context: Waste bin with a lid, a small handle on top and vertical ridges on its body. Used for delete buttons, removing items from a list, emptying a folder and recycle-bin views.

upload.context: Arrow pointing up out of an open tray. Used for upload buttons, attaching files, importing data, publishing content and sending files to the cloud.
